executor_address.description: Account address used to evaluate the script; must be a valid bech32 address.

script_address.description: Script bech32 address to inspect; mutually exclusive with script_name.

script_name.description: Optional nameservice name of the script to inspect (e.g., "example.dys").

dysonprotocol.script.v1.QueryFunctionSch.title: Query Function Schema Request
dysonprotocol.script.v1.QueryFunctionSch.description: QueryFunctionSchemaRequest requests function schemas for a script. Either script_address or script_name must be provided. The script will be introspected to extract schemas for all public functions.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.QueryFunctionSch.title: Query Function Schema Response
dysonprotocol.script.v1.QueryFunctionSch.description: QueryFunctionSchemaResponse contains function schemas extracted from a script.
